Use case: stylized-concept. Game animation sheet. The provided image is ONLY the approved monster design reference, NOT the desired camera angle. Redraw the SAME monster in the requested new direction.
EXACT OUTPUT: 1536x1024 landscape PNG. EXACT evenly spaced 6 columns x 4 rows, 24 poses. Each cell 256x256, one full monster per cell, generous 35px empty transparent margins on ALL sides. Entire creature and ALL limbs INCLUDING attack arms fit in maximum 180x180px region centered in each cell; keep scale consistent across poses. No border, no grid, no captions, no shadows, no glow, no background texture. Genuine transparent RGBA.
Maintain the approved detailed pixel-art appearance with crisp visible square pixel clusters and muted colors, do not change costume or identity. Feet ground anchor near local (128,210); no translation between cells. Each row left-to-right is a coherent six-frame motion sequence.
Row 1 IDLE: neutral; inhale; shoulders raised; exhale; head twitch; neutral recovery. Tiny motion, fixed feet.
Row 2 WALK: clearly alternating left/right foot contacts and passing poses, moderate stride, upright or species-appropriate hunch, gentle opposing arm swing. Six distinct articulated poses, coherent cycle.
Row 3 RUN: a DIFFERENT cycle from walk: forward leaning torso, long reaching stride, compressed passing pose, opposite long stride, feet briefly airborne, recovery. For heavy creatures use forceful charging steps. Never reuse walk poses simply faster.
Row 4 ATTACK: ready; arm(s) pulled back; maximum windup; decisive forward strike; follow-through; return toward ready. Runner claw swipe; stalker pounce; clicker two-arm swipe; bloater heavy downward slam; shambler chest/spore-release gesture without drawn cloud; rat king broad dominant-arm sweep. Attack direction matches facing.
Keep stable anatomy and readable silhouette, no morphing, no duplicated identical rows. All four motion sequences must be newly drawn in the specified direction.
CHARACTER: Thin recently infected humanoid, torn olive jacket, gray torn trousers, pale bald head with small rust-orange fungal patches, thin arms.
MANDATORY CAMERA: BACK VIEW, facing NORTH/up, away from viewer in ALL 24 frames. We see back of head, back of shoulders, spine or back of jacket, backs of legs. Never show front face, chest, or front torso. Attack extends AWAY from camera, toward top of cell. Slight overhead RPG camera.
